The `cppcheck` error "unknown macro" for `DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY` indicates that the static analysis tool is not recognizing this macro. While a `__CPPCHECK__` guard is present, it seems `__CPPCHECK__` is not being defined when `cppcheck` is run, or `cppcheck` is not fully processing the Zephyr headers that define `DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY`.

To resolve this, we can define a dummy `DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY` macro using an `#ifndef` guard. This ensures that if `cppcheck` (or any other tool) encounters `DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY` before it's properly defined (e.g., if it doesn't parse `zephyr/devicetree.h` correctly), it will use our dummy definition. For the actual compiler, `DT_INST_FOREACH_STATUS_OKAY` will be defined by Zephyr's device tree headers, so the `#ifndef` block will be skipped, preventing any conflicts.
